description: A biology lab with pale green tiles and many plants by the windows. Young students in white lab coats work at black benches with a microscope, petri dishes of moss, a tray of flowers, a pile of seed pods and small glass tanks with plants. In the middle a young woman in white gloves holds a green frog in her cupped hands, holds it out towards the viewer and smiles widely. Other students hold plant pots, and a teacher in a lab coat stands in the doorway with a tray of seedlings.
